RecoverableStatus.description:
One reinsurer's leg of a confirmed recovery.

PENDING ─▶ NOTIFIED ─▶ AGREED ─▶ BILLED ─▶ COLLECTED
               └──────────┴─────────┴──▶ DISPUTED ──▶ (back to an active state)
                                      └──▶ WRITTEN_OFF
RecoverableStatus.title: RecoverableStatus

RecoveryCandidateStatus.description:
docs/PRODUCT.md — Recovery Candidate lifecycle.

NEEDS_REVIEW ─▶ IN_REVIEW ─▶ CONFIRMED ─▶ NOTICE_DRAFTED
                      └──▶ REJECTED
(inputs change → recalculation → new immutable RecoveryCalculation;
 a CONFIRMED candidate reverts to NEEDS_REVIEW)
RecoveryCandidateStatus.title: RecoveryCandidateStatus

The notice provision as free text, plus — where the analyst can state it —

TreatyVersionStatus.description:
Lifecycle of one treaty version (the immutable executable unit).

DRAFT ──▶ PARSING ──▶ EXTRACTING ──▶ NEEDS_VALIDATION ──▶ VALIDATED ──▶ ACTIVE
                                             └──────────────┘
                      (post-validation change → new version; old → SUPERSEDED)
TreatyVersionStatus.title: TreatyVersionStatus
